en.summary: Reports suggest Andy Burnham may abandon the state pension triple lock guarantee, which would allow pensions to rise by nearly £500 next year, potentially to fund social care reforms.

en.title: Merseyside blaze that killed mother and three children caused by lithium-ion battery
en.summary: A lithium-ion battery used in common consumer devices including vapes, e-bikes and e-scooters caused a fatal house fire in Merseyside that killed a mother and three children. Fire officials warn about the thermal runaway risks these batteries can pose.
